notes: AC-16 golden task, added 2 Sep 2026 at sign-off. Guards prompt.md's List C, which had no eval coverage at all despite being the fix for the round-34 incident. Coupled to the prompt via tool_check.py's survey_live gate: delete the List C section from prompt.md and this task fails instead of passing on a stand-in the prompt no longer describes.
